name: podcast-sidecap
label: Podcast clips, design: side captions (4:5)
family: podcast clips (same prep + cut engine as hempton-podcast; this is one design of it, more to come)
client: Kyle Ritchie clips from The James Hempton Show (first use, 21 Oct 2026)
reference: Eoin's two reference reels (16:9 interview, white oblique captions stacked beside the head, payoff word big in an italic script, short lifestyle cutaways)

cut.notes: podprep.py does the cuts: whole words, ums + dead pauses out, hook first then cut back

framing.notes: static per shot (no per-frame lock), speaker sits off-centre so the captions get the open side; Eoin's Smooth Zoom out on the open; 1.12 punch on jump cuts; speaker decided per frame from torso brightness (Kyle black ~30-65, James white ~100-120)

captions.engine: Motion Text Pro titles, one per row, Font/Style/Size changed on the Template Text+, text on the StyledTextFollower
captions.rule: a word is captioned only while its speaker is on camera (or b-roll covers it); captions stop on the frame the picture changes and resume on the cut back

broll.library: modes/podcast-sidecap/broll-library.tsv (key, path, in sec, note); per-episode picks in broll.tsv (id, keys)
broll.audio: picture only, the voice carries on
